name: Dusk Princess

features.name: Super Cascades
features.description: Every regular symbol of a winning type is removed, not just the winning cluster, before new symbols fall.

features.name: Blessing Bar
features.description: Wins fill a bar that drops wilds with multipliers when full, needing two more symbols each time.

features.name: Growing wild rewards
features.description: Each activation can add another wild or raise the multiplier by values from 1x to 500x.

review:
A night-sky, gem-filled cluster game on 6x5 with Super Cascades – when a symbol wins, every symbol of that type leaves the grid, not just the winning ones.

Winning symbols also fill the Blessing Bar. The first fill needs an 8-symbol win, and each later fill needs two more. When it's full, it drops wilds with a multiplier, and each activation can add another wild or raise the multiplier – anywhere from 1x up to 500x. 10,000x max in every mode.
